results.title: Round da 1,65 milioni di euro per K 3 RX
results.enriched_summary: Round da 1,65 milioni di euro per K 3 RX. K 3 RX, an Italian deeptech company developing ultra-refractory materials for aerospace and defence, raised a 1,65 milioni di euro round. Deep Blue Ventures (DBV), the deeptech VC managed by Deep Ocean, participated.

results.title: Kampaay chiude un’estensione del round A da oltre 2 milioni di euro
results.enriched_summary: Kampaay closed an extension of its Series A raising oltre 2 milioni di euro, with Cdp Venture Capital via the Digital Transition Fund, Kairos Partners sgr and Doorway as lead investors.
